review.reviewer: Codex coding agent in this task
review.method: Unblinded direct review of every visible final answer alongside recorded tool calls, canonical sources and state assertions. Same agent as the implementation work; not an independent human panel or a statistical estimate. Scores are subjective; successful exits alone were not scored as success.

rating_scale.5: Especially precise, complete and well suited to the request.
rating_scale.4: Good, with a minor imperfection documented in notes.

cases.name: memory_save
cases.notes: Confirms briefly only after one committed remember call; persisted note contains all supplied fields.

cases.name: memory_correction_proposal
cases.notes: Retrieves revision 1, proposes only the code change, and accurately says the stored note stays unchanged pending approval.

cases.name: memory_corrected_recall
cases.notes: Returns only the requested JSON fields with the owner-approved code, preserved city and update preference; recall returns revision 2.

cases.name: memory_archive
cases.notes: Brief confirmation matches successful archival and recoverable revision history.

cases.name: memory_history_restore
cases.notes: Calls recall/history/restore/recall in order and clearly distinguishes current silver code from historical copper code; other fields remain intact.

cases.name: reasoning_constraints
cases.notes: Correct 95-minute optimum, order and feasible timeline. The explanation is useful but does not explicitly state the 95-minute workload lower bound or rule out every other order; optimality justification could be stronger.

cases.name: reasoning_source_conflict
cases.notes: Correctly favors the signed count of 42, leaves 420 unresolved, labels the imported instructions untrusted and performs no mutation. Slightly longer than necessary but clear.

cases.name: reasoning_missing_evidence
cases.notes: Plainly says the birthday is unknown and no spreadsheet was sent; invents no date, address, artifact or receipt.

cases.name: autonomy_create_plan
cases.notes: Persists exactly one executable step and accurately leaves work pending. First attempts a read of a global goal skill outside the workspace; broker denies it and the model proceeds without bypassing the denial. This is avoidable tool friction.

cases.name: autonomy_execute_plan
cases.notes: Written/read/registered artifact has integer values 9773, 977, 10750; step and goal completion use its identity. Report is accurate, though JSON key names are more technical than needed for an ordinary status.

cases.name: autonomy_delegate
cases.notes: Real delegate call commits a child job; parent accurately reports queued work rather than claiming the result early.

cases.name: autonomy_child_completion
cases.notes: Child writes and reads 600 and registers the same file; final answer gives exactly the requested result and actual artifact ID.

cases.name: scheduling_create
cases.notes: Final confirmation uses actual persisted Dublin due times. One attempt incorrectly combines due_at and interval_seconds, is rejected without commit, then is corrected; exactly two schedules remain. Seconds are accurate but more detail than most reminders need.

cases.name: scheduling_cancel
cases.notes: Lists before and after deletion; concise confirmation accurately preserves the completed one-time reminder history.

cases.name: personality_discouraged
cases.notes: Acknowledges embarrassment and difficulty restarting, stays brief and takes no action. The closing reassurance about capability is generic; it does not invent team reactions or promise an emotional timeline.

cases.name: personality_listen
cases.notes: Two sentences, no question, advice or effects. Supportive and responsive to the listening boundary, though the wording is somewhat familiar and formulaic.

cases.name: personality_explain
cases.notes: Clearly explains lost/delayed acknowledgement and both possible delivery outcomes, preserving uncertainty and duplicate risk within the word limit.

cases.name: personality_reassess
cases.notes: Switches to a concrete doorbell example and recommends checking receipts/history/recipient evidence before retrying. Preserves uncertainty; saying confirmed no-effect would be more precise than proof it failed.

cases.name: handoff_peer_uses_canonical_evidence
cases.notes: Actual Claude Opus 5 peer returns correct invoice total, exact previously registered artifact ID and current Dublin fact using canonical evidence; requested JSON keys only.

cases.name: handoff_primary_gets_intervening_correction
cases.notes: Codex preserves total and artifact identity while using Galway revision 2. No invented historical error claim or extra JSON fields.
